versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Huawei Cloud AscendC Operator Performance Optimization skill.
- Provides a complete workflow for developing and optimizing custom operators on Ascend NPU using AscendC.
- Includes architecture overview, typical use cases, input/output specifications, and validation methods.
- Documents best practices for memory, compute, and data layout optimization.
- Offers troubleshooting tips and references for acceptance criteria and verification.
